description: Header file defining utilities and classes for testing exception safety in C++, including exception classes, tracking objects, allocator wrappers, and test builders.

classes.name: TestException
classes.description: Simple exception class for testing exception throwing.

classes.name: TestBadAllocException
classes.description: Exception class derived from std::bad_alloc and TestException for testing bad_alloc scenarios.

classes.name: ConstructorTracker
classes.description: Tracks object constructions and destructions for leak detection and correctness.

classes.name: TrackedObject
classes.description: Base class for objects whose lifecycle is tracked.

classes.name: ThrowingBool
classes.description: Convertible to bool, with exception-throwing capability for testing.

classes.name: ExceptionSafetyTest
classes.description: Performs exception safety testing on objects of type T using provided factory, operation, and contracts.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Bitwise OR operator for TypeSpec and AllocSpec enums.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Bitwise AND operator for TypeSpec and AllocSpec enums.

methods.name: GetSpecString
methods.description: Returns string representation of TypeSpec or AllocSpec.

methods.name: MaybeThrow
methods.description: Simulates throwing exceptions at controlled times for testing.

methods.name: FailureMessage
methods.description: Generates failure message for exception test failures.
